verdict.rationale: The firm has a dedicated Legaltech & ALS page stating it was the first Indian law firm to adopt AI/ML-based legal tech, citing 20-30% efficiency gains in AI contract review, plus a named incubator (Prarambh) for legaltech startups — this goes beyond a marketing mention with a specific claimed capability. However, no named AI tool/product, no policy document on AI use/governance, and no client-facing AI usage disclosure are provided. missing for 10: named AI tool or product with specifics, formal AI use/ethics policy, independent corroboration of AI practice claims.
